findings.title: Existing publishing representation changes the next step.
findings.body: PULSE’s official 24hrs client page identifies an established publishing relationship. MLC records for “UCLA” UVAJ2Q, “What You Like” WVARSA and “Lie Detector” LVC6ML show 24HRS MUSIC PUB → Concord claims. Confirm the applicable agreements, territories and catalog periods before proposing new administration. Artist-named publisher claims with empty writer chains are held for entity-control verification and are not counted as apparent gaps.

findings.title: Separate visible claims from unresolved writer interests.
findings.body: Your legal-name variants are evidenced on 171 unique composition groups (186 recordings). Of these, 89 have a positive claim whose own writer chain names your identity; 33 further groups carry an artist-named publisher needing control verification. The remaining 49 have no attributable claim identified in the reviewed data and merit split/representation investigation. Same-title records connected by reviewed recordings are grouped and flagged in the downloadable audit. None of these counts establishes actual payment.

findings.title: UCLA carries both a valid work and conflicting recording links.
findings.body: The sampled “UCLA” recording shows 236,728,076 Spotify plays. Its matching MLC work UVAJ2Q shows 100% total known shares, including 24HRS MUSIC PUB → Concord. The same recording identifier also appears in the returned recording lists for “MY SONG FEAT. 24HRS” MV9SST and “TOP FLOOR FEAT. 24HRS & KELVYN COLT” TD0Z7H. Review the recordings and work identities with the existing administrator before any delinking or dispute; the public data is not proof that royalties were redirected.

findings.title: Verify writer credits on two highly exposed features.
findings.body: “LOWKEY” LVBB2T shows 75% total known shares, and “BACK OUT (FEAT. TY DOLLA $IGN)” BA44BT shows 90%. Their current writer lists do not identify your legal-name variants, despite the reviewed recordings crediting you as an artist. The sampled recordings show 19,060,263 and 12,348,319 Spotify plays respectively. Confirm the exact composition/recording matches and obtain the writing or feature agreements before asserting that any writer credit or ownership is missing.

findings.title: Recent releases and identity variants need a separate cleanup pass.
findings.body: Of 50 reviewed 2026 recordings, 25 have no MLC work identified in the evidence reviewed. Label metadata also alternates Robert Davis, Robert Dozier Davis III and several shorter or misspelled forms. MLC records attach different IPIs to plain “ROBERT DAVIS”; do not merge them on name alone. Verify the primary account, review the recent titles against your administrator’s delivery records, and keep the earlier Royce Rizzy catalog as a separate discovery follow-up.
